patthana10.10:1.1: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana10.10:2.1: na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana10.10:3.1: na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... navipākattika nahetudukaṃ na vipākaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na vipākadhammadhammaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naupādinnupādāniyattika nahetudukaṃ na upādinnupādāniyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anupā dinnupādāniyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattika nahetudukaṃ na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅ kilesikaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... navitakkattika nahetudukaṃ na savitakkasavicāraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na avitakka vicāramattaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na avitakkaavicāraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... napītittika nahetudukaṃ na pītisahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sukhasahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na upekkhāsahagataṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nadassanattika nahetudukaṃ
patthana10.10:5.1: na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ
